items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: like Charlie and Max Fink and Rainey Solomon and Joe Calro, all them guys were playing, you know, all fiddle men

ctx.x: Oh, Dave was dead. No, he was dead. He died a few years ago.

Well, talking about Dave Perkins, you see, I used to make quite a few jobs, you know, in and around town, out of town too. And sometimes I couldn't make the job with him, see, and he'd say to me, come and say to me, see, man, he said, you know, you're playing with, all you're doing is playing with them Sweet Marie bands, he used to call them, band with them fiddles in it, see. Sweet Marie bands. Sweet Marie bands, see. And I used to tell him, I said, well, Dave, I said, man, I said, those are the fellas that are…
And you had pianists around that were playing?
